narrative.intro: Salus Worldwide Solutions has $518M in federal contract obligations for FY2026 to date. Salus Worldwide Solutions won 2 awards this fiscal year, with an average award size of $259M. Salus Worldwide Solutions obligations are up 178.5% year over year. Salus Worldwide Solutions recorded no obligations in FY21, FY22, FY23, or FY24 and $186M in FY25 before the current-year total. Salus Worldwide Solutions revenue is concentrated in air-transportation services: Nonscheduled Chartered Passenger Air Transportation accounts for $512M of obligations, and Other Support Activities for Air Transportation accounts for $5.7M. Salus Worldwide Solutions current-year totals are partial because the fiscal year is not complete. Salus Worldwide Solutions figures on this page represent contract obligations except where tables note award-value totals for largest awards and expiring contracts. Salus Worldwide Solutions performance this year reflects a rapid increase in federal demand compared with prior years, and the company’s work is tightly focused on a small set of large awards in air transportation markets.

sections.heading: What drove Salus Worldwide Solutions' FY2026 obligations?
sections.body: Salus Worldwide Solutions won 2 awards that produced $518M in obligations for FY2026 to date. Salus Worldwide Solutions average award size is $259M, so a small number of large contracts account for most obligations. Salus Worldwide Solutions obligations were up 178.5% year over year, reflecting a sharp increase from the $186M recorded in FY25.

sections.heading: Where are Salus Worldwide Solutions' obligations concentrated?
sections.body: Nonscheduled Chartered Passenger Air Transportation is the largest market for Salus Worldwide Solutions with $512M in obligations. Other Support Activities for Air Transportation is a much smaller market for Salus Worldwide Solutions with $5.7M in obligations.
